cache_reuse.reuse_policy: Pinned input/code/cache identity plus mandatory seven-model numerical parity; no pair-sum or cache write.
cache_reuse.compatibility_helper_note: R58 compatibility helper uses g for all rows; original unused lin block uses1+z. Correct full-stack fingerprint is recorded separately; selected rows are all log-eta rows.

angular_radial_null.null: a_j dipole/STF = 0 for j>=1; free monopole history, constant angular field and coherent V
angular_radial_null.law: conditional fixed-C Gaussian linear mean; no physical isotropy or empirical-selection calibration

additional_rows.meaning: correlated additional summaries of the same catalogue; no independent-tracer claim
